original_test_intent: Demonstrate that Full-Mirror memory corrects a primary-channel multi-device UCE through the mirror path and reports the event in the target B2CMI bank with correct address and controller attribution.
original_method: Preserve baseline and platform identity; validate POR or approved non-POR Full-Mirror topology, half-capacity/mapping and injector unlock through the referenced CE recipe; set dev0/dev1 masks to0x3, inject one UCE at0x100000000, capture B2CMI status/address/misc raw and show outputs, confirm address alignment plus mirrorcorrerr, mccmdmirrregion and bankindex, then go and collect recovery/health evidence.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates the mirror recipe, target mapping, B2CMI field oracle and recovery, and drives the one-time UCE/go sequence while the agent correlates captured evidence.
required_inputs: CScripts version/hash/license and approved CE-recipe dependency
Mirror topology/capacity, target address-to-primary MC/DIMM and B2CMI bank mapping
Exact multi-device mask semantics and approved B2CMI status/misc expected fields
Dedicated maintenance window, live serial/OOB and recovery/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with serial/OOB recovery
Preserve existing error evidence and reject an invalid mirror baseline
Do not guess target, masks or register bits; inject once only
Stop on wrong bank/address, unexpected reset, failed correction/scrub or degraded mirror state
No automatic retry; restore temporary mirror/debug/injection settings and verify health
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved topology, mapping, harness and field oracle
Observe one approved injection and collect exact B2CMI/system evidence
Correlate mirror correction and bank identity
Do not choose the destructive target, inject/retry independently or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve platform/mirror population, address and masks

review_improvement: Restores every source-specific B2CMI and mirror-correction requirement, making generic logs supporting evidence and preventing unapproved injection or invented register interpretations.
independent_technical_reasoning: A multi-device UCE is only survivable here because the transaction is mirrored. Therefore a later generic machine-check line cannot prove the intended path: the mapped address and bank must match, mccmdmirrregion must identify a mirrored transaction, and mirrorcorrerr must show correction plus scrub success. The exact two-device masks distinguish this event from the row164 CE and the row166 persistent failover case. One destructive injection is sufficient; retries would confound attribution.
